name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer advancing the fully permitted Diablillos project in the Salta province of northwest Argentina. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study on Diablillos in June 2026, outlining an after-tax NPV of US$3.0 billion, and is targeting a Final Investment Decision in Q2 2027 with first production by year-end 2029. AbraSilver trades on the TSX under ABRA and on the OTCQX under ABBRF.
